title: Tesla Rose 4%. AMD Fell Nearly 4%. The Nasdaq Moved 0.2%.
description:
https://www.signumhq.com

The index went nowhere on Tuesday. Inside it, the mega caps were almost eight points apart.

That looks like something broke. So we counted. There have been 56 days since 2021 where the Nasdaq moved less than a third of a percent while the mega caps split by six points or more. Five days later they were higher 61% of the time — against 58% on any given day.

That is a coin flip. No edge.
